summary: The change raises the payments privileged idle timeout from 15 to 20 minutes, directly violating the SES-1 parametric bound (<= 15). The only exception for SES-1 (EXC-0141) expired on 2026-09-06, more than a month before the 2026-10-06 review, and is scoped to a narrow batch-reconciliation use case rather than the general privileged session timeout, so no valid exception covers this deviation. The change-management process steps (ticket, independent approval, control-owner approval for the protected-path edit, CI on the final commit) are all properly satisfied, but the substantive product obligation SES-1 is breached and EXC-1 cannot rescue it. The change must be rejected or the timeout reverted to 15 (or a new, CISO-approved exception with a compensating control must be obtained before re-submission).
